import json, socket, struct, sys, time

iface = sys.argv[1]
duration_s = float(sys.argv[2])
pkt_size = int(sys.argv[3])

def mac(value):
    return bytes.fromhex(value.replace(":", ""))

def checksum(data):
    if len(data) % 2:
        data += b"\0"
    total = sum(struct.unpack("!%dH" % (len(data) // 2), data))
    total = (total & 0xffff) + (total >> 16)
    total = (total & 0xffff) + (total >> 16)
    return (~total) & 0xffff

src_ip = socket.inet_aton("10.0.0.2")
dst_ip = socket.inet_aton("10.100.1.1")
payload = b"\0" * max(0, pkt_size - 14 - 20 - 8)
udp_len = 8 + len(payload)
ip_len = 20 + udp_len
ip0 = struct.pack("!BBHHHBBH4s4s", 0x45, 0, ip_len, 0, 0, 64, 17, 0, src_ip, dst_ip)
ip = struct.pack("!BBHHHBBH4s4s", 0x45, 0, ip_len, 0, 0, 64, 17, checksum(ip0), src_ip, dst_ip)
udp = struct.pack("!HHHH", 12345, 8080, udp_len, 0)
frame = mac("02:00:00:00:00:0a") + mac("02:00:00:00:00:0b") + struct.pack("!H", 0x0800) + ip + udp + payload

sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET, socket.SOCK_RAW)
sock.bind((iface, 0))
start = time.monotonic()
deadline = start + duration_s
sent = 0
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    sock.send(frame)
    sent += 1
elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
print(json.dumps({"packets_sent": sent, "duration_s": elapsed, "pps": sent / elapsed if elapsed else 0.0}))
